Senior Backend Engineer — Payments Platform

Ledgerly is building the financial infrastructure for mid-market companies. Our platform moves billions of dollars a year, and our engineering team is small, senior and remote-first.

About the Role
You will design and operate the services that move money for thousands of businesses. You'll work closely with product, risk and compliance to ship reliable systems quickly.

What You'll Do
- Design, build and operate high-throughput payment services in Go and Python
- Own the reliability of our PostgreSQL and Redis data layer, including schema design and query optimization
- Build event-driven workflows on Kafka and expose them through well-documented REST and gRPC APIs
- Partner with product and compliance teams to ship features that meet PCI DSS requirements
- Mentor engineers through code reviews, design docs and pairing

Requirements
- 5+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong proficiency in Go or Python
- Deep experience with PostgreSQL, including indexing and query tuning
- Experience running services on AWS (ECS, RDS, SQS) with Docker and Terraform
- Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices and API design
- Excellent written communication skills and a strong sense of ownership

Nice to Have
- Experience with Kubernetes and Helm
- Familiarity with observability tooling such as Datadog or Prometheus
- Background in payments, banking or fintech
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect or similar certification is a plus

Benefits
- Competitive salary and equity
- Remote-first with quarterly team offsites in Denver
- $2,000 annual learning budget for courses, books and Kubernetes conferences
